messages:
elaine: quick question — Alpha Health wants a hosted POC. projected usage ~10k tokens/month. they asked if we can waive the min-charge for the pilot and give 50% off per-token for the first 30 days. any objections?

gabe: what's the likely ARR if they convert? and which model are they planning to hit?

elaine: small startup, early revenue, ARR unknown. model = redwood-text-medium (hosted). they said it's product validation; will scale if signals look good.

sam: ops note — serving that volume on hosted is trivial. no infra changes. recommend we create billing tags and soft rate-limits to avoid accidental spikes.

harper: finance here. we need an estimate of the revenue impact. if we waive the min-charge (~$5k) + apply 50% token discount for 1 month, that's material. also need legal entity + billing address before any waiver. looping in deal-desk.

deal-desk: opened request DD-8342 for tracking. please fill pricing-exception form: https://redwood.workflow/requests/DD-8342. attach signed pilot amendment when available.

legal: from a contracts perspective we prefer a short pilot amendment (60-90 days) and a basic data-handling attestation if we remove the min-charge. did they return the security questionnaire?

elaine: they returned a light SQ and standard SCCs, no residency constraints. customer wants minimal paperwork.

sam: alternative — issue a one-time coupon/credit instead of changing pricing tables. easier to reverse and standard for accounting. finance can treat as contra-revenue.

gabe: I can approve a one-time promo credit up to $10k without exec approval. structural per-token rate changes require finance + revenue ops sign-off.

harper: confirmed: finance ok for up to $10k coupon. for multi-month percentage discounts we'd prefer a paid pilot or a 3-month commit.

elaine: customer asks to waive min-charge for first 60 days and 50% off tokens for month 1 only. they want simple terms and quick turnaround.

deal-desk: provisional outcome: waive min-charge for 60 days and grant 30% token discount for month 1 (instead of requested 50%). conditions: (1) coupon used for billing, (2) 1-page pilot amendment attached to order, (3) legal sign-off. finance recorded the decision.

legal: I'll draft the 1-page pilot amendment and upload to DD-8342 by EOD. need company legal name + billing address + PO if available.

elaine: will collect details and send. @sam can you create coupon and set rate-limit tags? @infra-bot please create coupon ID when ready.

infra-bot: coupon created: COUPON-ALPHA-60D-30

infra-bot: details:
```
/coupon create --code COUPON-ALPHA-60D-30 --discount 30% --expires 1880000000 --note "Alpha Health pilot: waive min-charge 60d"
```

sam: billing tags and soft rate limits configured. I'll add pilot monitoring to the dashboard and alert on token spikes.

elaine: sending terms + coupon to customer now. will update DD-8342 when signed. thanks everyone :tada:

gabe: thanks — keep me posted. if they push for >30% we escalate.

harper: accounting memo entered for the coupon. closing loop once amendment is signed.

legal: draft uploaded to DD-8342 (link). please review before sending.

elaine: ack. sending out now, will RTB in thread once signed. :thumbsup:
